evidence.text: Use supersymmetry, holomorphy and the effective superpotential to obtain glueball–two-graviton couplings. Tree-level scalar exchange and the Källén–Lehmann representation give a propagator function regular around zero momentum.

evidence.text: Contour deformation and crossing express subtracted dispersion relations through positive partial-wave spectral densities. sources.title: Sampling the Graviton Pole and Deprojecting the Swampland

evidence.text: Impose functional equalities at Chebyshev nodes in −1<t<0 or −1/3<a<0. Endpoint clustering resolves rapid variation while avoiding the graviton pole; fixed-t also excludes t=−1 because its kernel becomes singular at μ=1.
